active_agents.blocked_by: BytePlus ModelArk 5-hour rolling session quota reset (~22:22 CEST)

coordination_rules: 1. Exactly ONE agent may own a given write scope in the main working tree.
2. Reviewer agents default to read-only mode.
3. Multi-agent concurrent implementations require ephemeral git worktrees.
4. All agents must inspect ACTIVE_WORK.json and AGENTS.md before modifying any file.
5. An agent must update its handoff when stopping, being quota-blocked, or transferring ownership.
6. Completion requires evidence: files exist, 41/41 tests pass, continuity validates, handoff updated.
